title: Shaher Baanu Kahi Peet Kay Sar,
body:
Shaher baanu kahi peet kay sar,
Gorr mein meraa bachchaa dareigaa
Nanha laasha karoon dafn kyun kar,
Gorr mein meraa bachchaa dareigaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Aah nanhaa kafan mein bathaaoon,
Apney haathoun sey usko pinhaaoon
Khaak mein usko kyun kar litaaoon,
Gorr mein meraa bachchaa dareigaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Chounk kar jab lahed mein uttheigaa,
Koyi usko na apna dikhegaa
Meray pehloo ko dhoondaa kareigaa,
Gorr mein meraa bachchaa dareigaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar hai mitthi pey takyaa kahaan hai,
Khaak toshak hai jhoola kahaan hai
Sab toh sab maa ka pakhwaa kahaan hai,
Gorr mein meraa bachchaa dareigaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Loriyaan qabr mein kaun deigaa,
Kaun sojaao pyaarey kaheigaa
Doodh yeh laal kiskaa piyegaa,
Gorr mein meraa bachchaa dareigaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Dafn kardo yeh nanhey sey jee ko,
Sounmp dethi hoon rooh-e-nabi ko
Dam karo padd kay naad-e-Ali ko,
Gorr mein meraa bachchaa dareigaa
